verdict.rationale: Bento documents a public REST API in depth. It covers HTTP Basic auth conventions, an endpoint reference browser and error diagnostics, plus endpoint docs for events, batch subscribers (1–1000 per request), broadcasts, chat, and data deletion. First-party SDKs and a CLI build on the same API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
